About Us
We would like to welcome you to Goomeri Bush Camp, our little piece of paradise. We are a family operated and orientated DOG FRIENDLY park, located 3km from the township of Goomeri. We are an OFF GRID (no power) PROPERTY - but we do have full amenities including Laundry & a great Camp Kitchen. Our camping areas are very spacious with some secluded sites. We have several dams where you can go canoeing, and swimming when they are full. All campsites are well grassed, with individual fireplaces, and the creek side campsites in main camping area all have water points. We also have a communal firepit, amenities with showers, toilets and laundry and a rustic camp kitchen. We are set 2km from the front gate, creating our own private, quiet sanctuary.

Features
Goomeri Bush Camp is situated on a 300 acre farm in the heart of country Queensland. We are conveniently located 2.5hours from Brisbane, you can come and enjoy our piece of paradise and get back to nature. Come and stay, you are sure to enjoy yourselves in the serenity. If you want something a little more interesting and physical to do we have lots of wildlife to check out, birdwatching, walk trails, push bike riding and picnics.

About Us
We would love to welcome you to Goomeri Caravan and Bush Camp , our little piece of paradise in the bush. We are a family owned park, located 3km from the township of Goomeri. We have a very spacious main campground, as well as some secluded spots for those who seek privacy and quiet (or the space to make a bit of noise without upsetting the neighbours!). Situated on almost 300 acres, you will have access to several dams, great for canoeing, paddle boarding and kayaking, as well as swimming. The campground runs alongside Nangur Creek, which runs seasonally. All of our campsites are grassed and kept beautifully manicured, with fire pits at each site, and access to water points at our creekside sites. Bush walking is a big hit with our campers, with a number of well marked walking tracks throughout the property. You’ll enjoy a hot shower, clean toilets and a laundry, as well as a rustic, bush themed camp kitchen that our campers absolutely love! Set 2kms from the front gate, you’ll be able to enjoy peace and quiet away from road noise.
We all love a campfire,  Saturday night (weather depending) we hope you will join us for Happy Hour and some damper around our communal campfire in the corral. Without city or town lights, Goomeri Bush Camp is an exceptional spot for star gazing, and the sunsets we experience are amazing. Come and stay with us, enjoy our peace and quiet, as well as many local attractions, including local wineries, Boat Mountain, Kinbombi Falls or a meal at the local pub or bakery!

Location/Facilities
Location
Nestled amongst some of SE Queensland s picturesque countryside, Goomeri Bush Camp is a 3 hour drive North West of Brisbane.  As you are entering the region of Goomeri from Kilkivan, look for the sign when you are 3kms East of Goomeri. You then drive in 2.5kms from the entrance to the camp grounds.  We are 3km from Goomeri on the way to Kilkivan.  The location is centrally located to many of SE QLD s tourist attractions such as the Eumundi Markets and the South Burnett Wine Trail and right on the doorstep of some big festivals such as the Gympie Music Muster and Goomeri Pumpkin Festival. Goomeri Bush Camp is located on a picturesque 300acre property in the beef, cropping and wine region of the South Burnett.  The campsite is located on wide flats on the side of a quaint windy creek and surrounded with rolling hills perfect for morning stroll.  We often see possums, koalas, kangaroos, deer and abundant birdlife. There are also beef cattle and horses on our working farm.
Perfect to just take in the beautiful scenery.  At night you may like to join in an occasional communal camp fire or retreat to your camp with your family.
Facilities
All weather access road,  suitable for all types of vehicles, including 2WD.
Our campground is located creek-side on a large flat creek bed with plenty of shady trees.
Pets are welcome at owners discretion, however, all animals must be kept on a lead at all times. You are responsible for your pets at all times, including cleaning up after your pet to avoid inconvenience to other campers. You must never leave your pet unattended.
Clean amenities and laundry
Dump Point
Rustic camp kitchen
Generators allowed 8am-6pm
Gas bottle re-fills are available on site (9kg bottles $37, 4kg bottles $20)
Group sites available for friends camping together
No powered sites or slabs
Family friendly
Bore water available
Communal campfire, with Happy Hour and damper sampling each Saturday evening
Plenty of parking
BYO Food, Drinks and Ice. The closest supermarket is 3kms away
Fire rings on every campsite
Collect firewood yourselves and its free, or its available for purchase delivered to your door
No trail bike riding allowed

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Here are some of the questions we are frequently asked at Goomeri Bush Camp . We hope it helps you plan your next camping trip with us.
Click on a question below to see the answer:
Are dogs allowed?
Yes, dogs are allowed at management s discretion. Dogs are to be on a leash at all times to preserve our beautiful wildlife and also that you clean up after them. There is also a large off leash dog area for your dog to enjoy!
What is your general payment and refund policy?
EVENT WEEKEND BOOKINGS A one-night deposit is required at time of booking to secure your booking with FULL payment the week prior to assist with a smoother & faster check in process.
TICKETED EVENTS – Cancellations with MORE than 7 days’ notice will incur an admin fee of 50% of ticket price.
TICKETED EVENTS – Cancellations with LESS than 7 days’ notice. NO refund or credit given
GENERAL BOOKINGS – a one-night deposit is required at time of booking to secure your booking with FULL payment due on arrival.
If you have a change of plans and need to amend the dates of your booking, NO PROBLEM, have your dates ready & we have you covered. If you need to cancel your booking with more than 7 days’ notice, we will happily apply your deposit payment minus a $10.00 admin fee to your Guest account for use within 12 month period.
Any cancellations within 7 days, a one-night cancellation fee is applicable.
All public holiday, long or event weekend bookings cancelled with less than 7 days’ notice – NO refund or CREDIT will be given.
Non-arrivals or stay cut short – NO refund or credit
ABSOLUTELY NO REFUNDS OR CREDITS GIVEN FOR INCLEMENT WEATHER.
Please understand that we are a small business, the weather or individual change of mind or circumstances are out of our control.
Do you have a Dump Point?
Yes, we do.
Is there drinking water available?
Yes, unfiltered rainwater is available both outside of the amenities and the camp kitchen.
Are campfires allowed?
Yes you are welcome to have a small campfire in the rings provided at your site. Please keep safety in mind and remove all flammable items from around your fire.
Is there water available?
Yes there is a reliable bore water source. You are welcome to use this for showers and everything else other than drinking.
Can we buy wood for our campfire?
Yes, we have firewood available for a charge. We will deliver to your door.
Do you have mobile reception?
Yes we do have mobile reception. Of Course, it is best to check with your phone provider if concerned.
Can we use a generator?
Yes you are welcome to use a small generator between 8am and 6pm.
How far to the closest supermarket?
Our turn off is 3kms from Goomeri and our driveway is 2.5kms. A total of 5.5kms to the closest supermarket. They are a Foodworks.
Do you have gas bottle re-fills?
Yes we do, $37 for a 9kg bottle, $20 for 4.5kg bottle.
Is the water from our own shower in our van allowed to flow onto the ground?
Yes, that s fine. Our trees and gardens will love it.
What is in the camp kitchen?
Our rustic camp kitchen has gas facilities, including a large BBQ and 2 Burner cooker. and fridge. You will also find hot water, a kettle, pots, pans, crockery, cutlery and more. Please note that there is no electricity in our campgrounds.
